title: Staff
help: Moderation per moderator, when the team is active, weekly activity, staff discipline and safety limit blocks (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes).

stats.title: Moderation stats · {period}
stats.note: Automatic (bot) and test cases are left out; removed cases are not in the totals.
stats.empty: No moderation actions in this period.

coverage.staff: Staff activity (cases by human moderators + appeals decided): {count}
coverage.note: Stronger shade = busier, in quarter steps up to the busiest hour. Columns are hours 0–23 in {zone} (the server's birthday time zone, set under Birthdays; UTC when none is set).

blocks.title: Safety limit blocks ({count})
blocks.ownersOnly: Only the bot owners can lift a block (like /staff restore).

activity.error: Activity could not be loaded (database unavailable).
activity.note: Inactive = no moderation work and under 20 messages. Actions are cases they created; reviews are automod and verification cards.
activity.title: Staff activity · week of {start}

discipline.title: Staff discipline
discipline.ownersOnly: Only the bot owners can warn staff members, see their staff warnings or give back removed staff roles (like /staff warn, warnings and restore).
discipline.reason: Reason: which admin rule they broke (sent to them)
discipline.giveConfirm: Give this staff member a warning? At {limit} active warnings their staff roles are removed.
discipline.warningsError: Warnings could not be loaded (database unavailable).
discipline.removedError: Removed staff roles could not be loaded (database unavailable).
discipline.noneSaved: No removed staff roles are saved.
discipline.help: Staff warnings expire; at {limit} active warnings the staff roles are removed (the staff guard removes them too). The member is DMed and the mod log gets a line.
discipline.restoreNote: Restoring gives back the saved roles the bot can still manage. A safety limit block (too many bans or kicks in 10 minutes) is lifted separately (Safety limit blocks).
